title: APEC summit: Xi, Trump and Putin to hold first-ever trilateral in China
summary: Presidents Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin are scheduled to sit down for a three-way summit today. Follow live.
byline: Mark Hallam, Karl Sexton, Wesley Dockery, Mahima Kapoor

image.caption: Trump, Xi and Putin are scheduled to sit down for talks today in ChinaImage: Iori Sagisawa/REUTERS

blocks.text: Welcome back to our coverage on Thursday

blocks.caption: World leaders pose for a group photo at the APEC summitImage: Iori Sagisawa/REUTERS

blocks.text: President Donald Trump is set for a historic meeting with Presidents Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the APEC summit today.
Xi traveled to the airport on Wednesday to personally greet Trump on arrival in a rare signal of diplomatic respect.
Putin also approached Trump before fellow leaders got into position for the traditional summit family photo.
The two shook hands, while Xi looked on.
A bilateral summit between Trump and Putin might not come to pass while both are in China.
We'll have the latest out of the summit in this blog, thank you for joining.
